title: Corpay's Corporate Payments Push Could Unlock Its Next Growth Phase
text: Corpay is rated BUY after strong 2Q26 results and raised full-year guidance, with robust earnings and revenue growth. CPAY is shifting focus from vehicle to corporate payments, targeting a $560 billion TAM with less than 1% current share. 2Q26 revenue rose 21% to $1.34B, adjusted EBITDA margin expanded to 57.3%, and free cash flow hit $1.6B TTM.

title: Siemens Healthineers: Successful Investment, Updating For H2 2026
text: Siemens Healthineers remains a high-conviction BUY with a reiterated €48/share price target, reflecting strong Imaging and Precision Therapy segments. I exclude Chinese recovery from my base case; growth is now driven by ex-China Imaging and Varian, with diagnostics seen as structurally impaired. 3Q26 results confirmed robust order momentum (1.3x book-to-bill), and margin strength (19.1%), and EPS guidance raised to €2.45, though tariff refunds contributed.

title: Trump fires back at Canada after Carney suspends trade talks, accuses US of last-minute 'power play'
text: President Donald Trump accused Canada of wanting the benefits of statehood on Truth Social after Canadian PM Mark Carney suspended U.S.-Canada trade negotiations over tariffs.

title: Synaptics' Chief Strategy Officer Disposed of Stock as 45,910 Shares Vested. Here's What to Know.
text: The disposition involved 15,954 shares at a weighted-average price of $110.58 per share on August 17. This was a non-discretionary event where shares were withheld by the company to satisfy tax obligations related to the vesting of equity awards.

title: Synaptics' Top Lawyer Sold Stock as a $7 Billion Merger Moves Toward Closing. Here's What to Know
text: The disposition of 20,274 shares was valued at about $2.2 million based on weighted average execution prices on August 17 and August 18. The activity included 14,218 shares withheld for tax obligations and 6,056 shares sold under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan established in September 2025.

title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise: AI Infrastructure And Juniper Could Unlock The Next Growth Phase
text: Hewlett Packard Enterprise earns a buy rating, driven by surging AI infrastructure demand and a strengthened networking business post-Juniper acquisition. HPE posted record Q2 FY2026 revenue of $10.7 billion (+40% YoY), with Cloud and AI revenue up 22.9% and Networking revenue up 148.2%. Profitability is improving: Q2 non-GAAP EPS grew 108% YoY, Cloud and AI operating margin nearly doubled, and free cash flow guidance was raised to at least $3.5 billion.

title: Is Brookfield Renewable a Better Buy Now Than It Was 6 Months Ago?
text: Brookfield Renewable's share price certainly looks more attractive than it did six months ago. Investors should be careful of falling knives.

title: Even After Doubling, Seneca Foods Corporation Offers Tasty Upside
text: Seneca Foods Corporation remains a 'buy' after a 107.5% stock surge since June 2023, driven by robust growth. Revenue and profitability have accelerated, with Q1 2027 revenue up 36.2% and broad-based volume gains across core categories. SENEA's recent acquisitions, notably Green Giant's US frozen business, are fueling expansion beyond organic growth.

title: Nvidia stock in focus as earnings loom and GPU price hikes approach
text: Nvidia stock price dropped sharply last week as traders refocused on the upcoming earnings report that will provide insights into its revenue and profitability growth. NVDA will also react to news on GPU price hikes, which may boost its revenue in the foreseeable future.

title: What Does a D-Wave Quantum Insider's Sale of 23,850 Shares Mean for Investors?
text: The executive disposed of 23,850 shares at $21.17 per share for an estimated value of ~$505,000 as of the August 17, 2026 transaction date. The disposal reduced the insider's direct equity holdings by 4%.

title: Which Energy ETF Is a Better Buy: Broad Vanguard Fund or Concentrated XLE?
text: State Street Energy Select Sector SPDR ETF offers a slightly lower expense ratio and higher liquidity than Vanguard Energy ETF. Vanguard Energy ETF provides broader exposure to the U.S. energy market with 112 holdings compared to only 21 for the State Street fund.

title: ABN AMRO: Improved Profitability And Surplus Capital Warrant An Upgrade
text: Higher profitability and abundant capital have done wonders for Dutch lender ABN AMRO, which has returned over 50% since my last update. Q2 results were strong: revenue, costs, and earnings all beat expectations, while the bank has hit management's ROE target two years ahead of schedule. With risk-weighted assets expected to remain flat through 2028, hitting management's capital target will require ABN to return over 100% of its net income to shareholders.

title: Rigetti Computing's COO Sells Over 9,000 Company Shares. What Does That Mean for Investors?
text: The disposal of 9,038 shares was executed at a weighted average price of $16.79 per share, totaling ~$152,000. The transaction reduced the insider's direct equity position by 3% of previous holdings.

title: Alibaba Group Announced Proposed Placing of New Shares in Hong Kong
text: HONG KONG--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE: BABA and HKEX: 9988 (HKD Counter) and 89988 (RMB Counter), “Alibaba,” “Alibaba Group” or the “Company”) today announced that it proposes to place newly issued ordinary shares of the Company (the “Placement Shares”) to non-U.S. persons outside the United States with an aggregate placing consideration of HK$80 billion, subject to market and other conditions (the “Equity Placement”). The Equity Placement is being undertaken to extend.
